name: repeatability
label: REPEATABILITY
title: Repeatability: the same goal, the same result, every time
summary: Reliability and repeatability are the same thing here. Found once with a model, then replayed with none: the same steps, the same checks, the same result, until the controls really change. At the small scale it is one scenario that runs the same way every time.
